items.name: lookbook-strip
items.title: Lookbook Strip
items.description: A campaign photo you can shop: numbered hairline-ring hotspots, placed by percentage with their own positions for a mobile crop, each opening its product on your shadcn Popover — on hover with a pointer, on tap or Enter otherwise. The card grows out of the hotspot and folds back into it, held open until the fold has played (Motion; a fade under reduced motion). The same products are listed under the image, and hovering one marks its hotspot.
